headers.//: The deployment alias is not the site. Vercel serves byte-identical documents at project-beacon-*.vercel.app, canonicals and all, so the same pages were indexable at two origins and the only thing keeping them together was a canonical hint. Scoped by host so the header can never reach beaconlab.dev: a noindex on the real origin would remove the entire site from search, which is the sort of mistake that is silent for a week.
